Creating a strong online presence requires careful planning and execution from the ground up. Ecwid is a platform designed to make it easy for business owners to create an ecommerce site to sell your product. It offers the key features you need to not only maximize your profit margins and impress your customers, but also to do so in an efficient and affordable manner. Consider some of the benefits of using Ecwid for your ecommerce business.

#1: Ecwid Pricing

Pricing matters to every business, especially a startup or scaling e-commerce business. Ecwid pricing makes it highly fitting in most situations.

The free plan is a strong start. It’s a free plan you can keep forever or as long as you need to. There is no risk in launching your online store and trying it out. It’s easy to launch Ecwid right now to start a free trial.

Business owners can then elect to upgrade to the plan that fits their needs, with options ranging from as little as $21 up to the unlimited package at $89. From the ground up, each site offers to add a store to any website, selling at the same time on multiple sites and choosing from 30 free design themes. Add domains, features, support, and more to the level you decide.

#2: Simplified Inventory Management

For most ecommerce companies, inventory management is by far the most time consuming aspect. Meeting customer needs while retaining limited oversupply is financially critical, but not easy to do.

With Ecwid, you get the support you need seamlessly. Consider some of the benefits of the simplified inventory management tool. For example, Ecwid tracks your inventory for you. All you need to do is input the stock quantity for your products and variations, and the system automatically updates stock levels without you having to put in any additional effort.

Receive restock alerts so you don’t disappoint customers. You can also set custom out-of-stock behavior in situations to keep products displayed on the storefront or hidden from the storefront. It also offers pre-orders to capture customer orders even sooner. Check out the Ecwid inventory management process now.

#3: Streamline Shipping

It is possible to have hassle-free product shipping. To do so, Ecwid offers a suite of tools to make shipping operations smooth and transparent. It is critical for organizations to have a clean, transparent shipping process from both a timeline and fee standpoint. Nearly half of all customers abandon their carts due to hidden extra fees.

With Ecwid, you can provide both real-time and accurate shipping quotes from trusted carriers. That includes UPS, USPS, FedEx, and others. Additionally, Ecwid users can buy and print shipping labels instantly while offering both shipping (international and domestic) or local delivery options.

#4: Manage Orders Without Hassle

Orders are magical, indicating that a customer wants the product you have to offer. However, effective order management is essential to ensure that customers get what they need when they expect it. With Ecwid, users can manage the entire order lifecycle. That starts at the moment the order is placed and continues through delivery. To provide support to users, the intuitive dashboard Ecwid provides customers really is the powerhouse. It allows for various filtering options to find fulfillment status, date, and more.

Ultimately, the streamlined effectiveness of Ecwid for small business in its order management helps to reduce errors while also improves customer satisfaction. That helps to drive customer retention.

#5: Support and Tutorials

For those exploring Ecwid's standout features, it is critical to also consider the value of the company’s resources. Ecwid video guides provide novice users with exactly what they need to do to set up their e-commerce business, no matter their level of experience.

These resources may be invaluable to those looking to simply start up a new business without much experience, but they also help speed the process, ensuring the entire setup does not take longer than a matter of minutes.

You can check out all of the Ecwid tutorials now. That gives you insight into how easy this learning curve is.

#6: Marketing Powerhouse

Once your business is set up, customers can begin to see the products, buy, and interact with your business. That’s the foundation of success, but in nearly all situations, the hard part for many new companies is driving people to the website. Ecwid offers a number of key resources and tools to enhance and enable this outcome.

Users can use the software to attract more customers to their online store using marketing tools including resources for dynamic ads, discounts, and social media marketing. It’s possible to utilize Facebook’s commerce tools to promote and sell products on the platform and to use tools like TikTok, Instagram, and Pinterest to showcase products to drive sales to your site.

Additionally, Ecwid enables users to list products without cost on Google Search, Google Images, and Google Shopping. It allows you to use Google Ai to create highly effective Google Ads, too.

#7: Retention at Its Best

Once you get the sale or attract people to your website, Ecwid provides tools and resources to help business owners to retain those customers over time without burdening owners with dozens of tasks.

For example, users can tap into the power of loyalty programs, which help customers to build up to discounts with the orders they place. Utilization of remarketing with Google Ads, retargeting campaigns on Facebook, and streamlined ad campaigns for specific events or needs are all possible.

Utilize email campaigns, build subscription services, and develop newsletters for customers. All of this is done right on the dashboard, making it incredibly easy for companies to produce the results they desire in return sales. Check out the features to see just how many ways Ecwid for small businesses works with bringing customers back and building relationships.

Why Wait When Ecwid Features Empower Small Business Success?

With a free trial that lasts as long as you want, you could launch your small business today with Ecwid.
